scope: Preserve native circle geometry for circle_polygon and KiCad via copper; retain exact via center/diameter source decimals; derive combined profile bounds from authoritative regions.
status: Retained native-circle and source-bound repair with configured HyperDRC tests, strict Clippy/docs, formatting and capability cost evidence. Full consumer integration remains open.
construction: The fallible helper evaluates under STRICT, guards shared work-budget exhaustion, and constructs two semicircles. The kernel may split them during regularization. Generic circle_polygon uses the absolute finite radius for its native region while retaining signed report phase and every requested report sample (minimum 16); zero radius is the empty regularized region.
source_import: Via copper is shared across expanded layers and constructed from retained exact decimal center and half of exact size. Invalid diameters retain a source-construction diagnostic instead of publishing an apparently valid empty circle. Incomplete objects and centers without the existing finite compatibility view retain the parser historical skip behavior.
bounds: Profile construction combines each valid polygon native exact bounds through STRICT comparisons. A missing component certificate disables the cached bound; non-finite report coordinates are tracked independently. Finite spatial indices and nearest-rounded report bounding boxes are not newly certified by this change.
regressions: The unchanged public-loader source-circle fixture now retains the independent interior point on both F.Cu and B.Cu.
Decimal source coordinates near 2^53 and a radius beyond binary64 resolution retain exact bounds and distinguish interior/exterior points separated by 10^-30.
16, 17, 48 and 128 report samples preserve native area, bounds, boundary topology count, and point distance.
A coarse report polygon cannot shrink its authoritative circle bounds during profile construction.
Negative or unresolved helper radii remain failures, including unresolved input under an enclosing preview. Exhausted operations fail and a subsequent admitted retry succeeds.
The existing million-sample fixture is unchanged and passes with all 1,000,001 closed report coordinates retained.
Existing negative/zero/non-finite primitive-circle behavior and the complete library suite pass.
draft_evidence: circle-draft/manifest.json retains the separately tested draft and test-authoring corrections; its concurrent-suite elapsed time is not a benchmark.
remaining: Native line/arc clearance metrics still need adoption by DRC consumers, including filled-union boundary semantics and uncertainty propagation.
Component extraction/projection failures and caches, report-ring fallback promotion, finite spatial rejection and Option/filter_map readiness consumers remain open.
Broader pad, track, stroke, slot, custom geometry and other source-format fidelity remains open.
The legacy translated_circle wrapper still expects admitted input and can panic on an unresolved or denied construction; migration of its callers to fallible readiness paths remains open.
Report sampling is not covered by a total allocation/time budget. No full-workspace, pre-push, ASan, fuzz, coverage or formal completion is claimed.
